name: Inkou Oyaji to Shoujo
source:
The main character is a middle-aged man, who has been just fired. He frequently visits a town he likes to look for a job, but actually he just watches girls in school uniform on the road. As time passes, he can't stop his sexual desire and decides to follow target girls. And he luckily gets their personal information and secrets....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
